title: San Francisco mayor signs 45-day citywide data center moratorium
summary: Mayor Daniel Lurie signed a 45-day pause on data center development across San Francisco after a unanimous Board vote on Oct 6. Planning will study impacts, and the pause could be extended up to 22 months.
reason: An enacted local moratorium in the US tech hub is a concrete backlash step, but it is city-level and temporary, so T1.
